main_text.l: Votisque semper supplicibus colis,Quod inssa seruas, & potentiTegeris vsque Deo minorem.Quid tuta virtus praesidio PatrisPossit supremi, quid queat indolesAddicta Christo, PrincipisqueQuid valeant pia vota iustiHostilis ardens agminis impetusSensit retusus nuper, & aemulaeSensere, quae tristi cohortesCortracia cecidere pugna:Sensitq; Ductor, funera qui tibiAudax parabat dura Iovesivs:Quum vota risisset piorumSollicitasque preces superbus.Nam victa spreto Numine brachiisFidens iuventus cum Duce corruit:Vicitque caelestem precatusMiles opem metuendus hosti.Sic praepotenti Iessaides precePugnauit olim, quum rudis agminumFudit Philistaeas phalanges,Atque trucem feriit Gigantem:Quem mole vasta corporis arduiArmabat ensis, cuspis & aneaIngentis hastae: cuique pectusAere ferox solido micabat.Hic fastuoso lumine militem

page.notes: Verse lines are printed in italic with long s rendered as s; some words are doubtful: "Cortracia" and "Iessaides" as printed. Line-initial capitals of several lines are set in larger italic and read as printed.
